experiment: LDBC SNB REQUIRES_TOP_K templates: static TopK expressibility
execution_note: static judgment from template text and official SQL only; no LDBC query was executed (no SF data on iTiger), so nothing here is measured

protocol.universe: the 27 templates with claim_full_contract = REQUIRES_TOP_K in external_workloads/ldbc/coverage_annotation.jsonl

judgments.TOTAL_ORDER: LIMIT k is explicit and the sort list contains a key unique per result row (an entity id, or every grouping column of the official SQL's GROUP BY), so TopK(S, sort, k) states the full contract under a deterministic total order
judgments.TIEBREAK_MISSING: LIMIT k is explicit but the sort list ends in a non-key attribute (a name) while rows are per entity; TopK applies only after adding the entity id as the final tie-break
judgments.NOT_TOP_K: the contract is not a prefix of a ranked candidate result

protocol.row_grain_source: the official SQL where it fixes the grain (GROUP BY), else the template result schema

flags.nested_projection: a result column is a per-row collection; S then compares rows that hold nested values
flags.official_sql_ranking_lacks_tiebreak: the template's sort is total but the official SQL ranks in an inner LIMIT whose ORDER BY omits the tie-break
